name: Publish to BrewPage
description: Publishes HTML or Markdown to BrewPage (brewpage.app), free instant hosting, and returns a shareable HTTPS link. No account or API key needed. Private (unlisted) by default; public pages are listed in the gallery and indexed.
author: @kochetkov-ma

examples.prompt: Publish this report as a web page and give me the link
Share these meeting notes as a public page for 30 days
examples.call: {"content": "# Meeting notes\n\n- Ship v2 on Friday", "format": "markdown", "visibility": "public", "ttl_days": 30}

content.description: The full HTML document or Markdown text to publish

visibility.description: private (default: unlisted, anyone with the link can open it) or public (listed in the gallery and search; only when the user asks for it, never with secrets or personal data)
